test_title: PYST 41: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

Even when the child accused the relative of inappropriate behaviour, the parents continued to play perfect hosts at the party instead of addressing __the elephant in the room.__

options.text: Ignoring someone who seeks attention through false stories
A big problem everyone is ignoring or afraid to talk about

solution:
The correct answer is-**"A big problem everyone is ignoring or afraid to talk about"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given options, "**A big problem everyone is ignoring or afraid to talk about**" is most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.
 
• The idiom **"The elephant in the room"** is used when there a serious issue that no one wants to discuss or is willing to acknowledge.
 
 
• **Example:** The 60,000 retirees who had lost all or a portion of their pension remained like** an elephant in the room** throughout our discussions.
 
 
 
• Thus, ***option 4)*** is the correct alternative.
